elements.requirement: A person may not be appointed as a director of a company unless that person has attained the age of 16 years.
elements.quote: A person may not be appointed a director of a company unless he has attained the age of 16 years

elements.requirement: The minimum age requirement does not affect the validity of an appointment of a director that is not scheduled to take effect until the appointed person attains the age of 16 years.
elements.quote: does not affect the validity of an appointment that is not to take effect until the person appointed attains that age

elements.requirement: Where the office of director of a company is held by a corporation sole or otherwise by virtue of another office, appointing a person who has not attained the age of 16 years to that other office does not effectively make that person a director of the company until that person attains the age of 16 years.
elements.quote: appointment to that other office of a person who has not attained the age of 16 years is not effective also to make him a director of the company until he attains the age of 16 years

elements.requirement: Any appointment of a director made in contravention of section 157 is void.
elements.quote: An appointment made in contravention of this section is void

elements.requirement: Nothing in section 157 affects any liability of a person under any provision of the Companies Acts if that person purports to act as a director or acts as a shadow director, even though that person could not validly be appointed as a director by virtue of section 157.
elements.quote: Nothing in this section affects any liability of a person under any provision of the Companies Acts if he— (a) purports to act as director, or (b) acts as a shadow director, although he could not, by virtue of this section, be validly appointed as a director

elements.requirement: Section 157 has effect subject to section 158 concerning the power to provide for exceptions from the minimum age requirement.
elements.quote: This section has effect subject to section 158 (power to provide for exceptions from minimum age requirement)
